description: PlaceProto event sidecar. Adds the required PlaceProto location to a community.lexicon.calendar.event record stored in the same repository.

main.description: A PlaceProto event sidecar. eventUri names the community event this sidecar belongs to, in the same repository. The sidecar's location is the PlaceProto location of record; the community event's locations array is only a compatibility copy.

eventUri.description: AT-URI of the community.lexicon.calendar.event record in the same repository (repository DID, community event collection, record key). Follows the current event through edits; not a strongRef.

location.description: Where the event is occurring. One value from the open Location union.
